title: PriceTrace Official Channel Catalog Snapshot v1
description: Design-only source contract for immutable snapshots collected from an official distribution-channel source. It is not a runtime or database contract yet.
$comment: JSON Schema validates record shape. The companion bundle invariants in OFFICIAL_CHANNEL_PRODUCT_DATA_MODEL.md are also normative.
x-pricetrace-semantic-invariants: All source, listing snapshot, and offer IDs are unique within the bundle.
Every source_ref resolves to exactly one sources[].id in the same bundle.
Every singular source_ref and every source_refs item is checked; child claim refs are contained by their enclosing offer and listing refs.
Every non-null or non-empty common source field and offer source name has at least one claim-level source ref.
The declared hashes match their defined byte or RFC 8785 canonical JSON subjects.

A full collection is delisting-eligible only when its scope is explicit, collection_status is completed, expected and collected counts match, expected and collected pages match, pagination_exhausted is true, coverage sources are captured, errors is empty, and all cross-record checks pass.
The durable listing identity tuple is unique within a bundle, and collected_listing_count equals the number of those unique tuples.
A source_product_code or source_offer_code identity uses a non-null source-system namespace and direct source_ref; receipt compatibility is a separate reviewed decision.
Exactly one identifier has is_identity_basis=true when source_identity.basis is identifier.
A source-explicit delisted publication has non-empty source_text and all supporting source refs resolve to captured evidence.
valid_from must not be later than valid_until when both values are comparable.
Re-importing a bundle with the same snapshot content_hash is idempotent.

extensions.description: Namespaced channel-specific data. Core semantics must not be redefined here.

nullableTemporal.description: A source-declared date or date-time. Precision must not be invented.

previous_snapshot_id.description: Previous accepted snapshot UUID for the same channel and coverage scope, when known.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonicalized bundle with the snapshot.content_hash member omitted.

coverage.description: Defines what universe was collected and the evidence for completeness. full never means the whole channel unless scope_kind is entire_channel.

scope_key.description: Deterministic source-facing key for the category, collection, query, URL set, or other bounded scope. It is required for every non-entire, non-unknown scope.

collected_listing_count.description: Number of unique durable listing identity tuples in listing_snapshots; record_local identities count by record_local_id.

publisher_relation.description: Relationship of the publisher to the channel, not a product-match confidence.

access_scope.description: Authentication state only. Credentials, cookies, and tokens must never be stored.

raw_payload.description: Optional sanitized source payload. Authentication material and unrelated personal data are forbidden.

namespace.description: Stable identifier namespace used in durable identity keys, for example gs1:gtin.

sourceCode.description: A source-native product or offer code with its source-system namespace and direct evidence reference.

basis.description: record_local means that no cross-snapshot merge is allowed.

source_name.description: Exact source text. It must never be overwritten by a normalized or canonical name.

raw_attributes.description: Ordered source labels and values that do not yet have common semantics. Repeated labels are preserved.

sourceFieldRefs.description: Claim-level evidence for each common source field. Non-null/non-empty field values require at least one ref; that cross-field rule is enforced by the bundle validator.

source_value.description: Exact JSON-compatible source value after sanitization.

status.description: Official catalog publication state, not stock or completed-sale evidence. delisted requires an explicit source claim; absence-based lifecycle inference belongs outside this source contract.

amount_minor.description: Lossless non-negative decimal integer string in the currency's minor unit. It is a string to avoid IEEE-754 precision loss.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 of this listing snapshot's RFC 8785 canonical JSON with record_hash omitted.
